selected_test_policy: The fixture installs a real throwing JavaScript before hook, consumes only the actual current pending reason, requires exact selected identity and ordinary status, and reinstalls that same reason. It does not classify real stack overflow or replace the missing production hook/fatal owner.
cleanup: Actual native service stop/join precedes outer Scope retirement, realm cleanup, native queue close/release and Environment disarm. Every fixture physical descriptor has actual uv_fs_open/fstat/close storage; request observation entitlements are explicitly retained/released.
shutdown_selection: The accepted-close shutdown control waits for the real native close event before disabling JavaScript delivery. This isolates the original callback cleanup path from service-stop cancellation timing.
